_readme.what_this_file_is: A reference record of AviQR's SMS content for DLT (India TRAI) compliance — NOT a confirmed MSG91 bulk-import format. I could not verify MSG91 has a 'paste/upload JSON' template import feature at all; their documented flow is a manual dashboard form (Template Name, DLT Template ID, Sender ID, Content). Use this as your own tracking record and copy values into that form by hand.
_readme.why_it_cannot_be_imported_as_is: dlt_template_id and sender_id are intentionally blank below — they don't exist yet. A real DLT Template ID (long numeric string) and Sender ID (exactly 6 alphanumeric characters) are only issued by your telecom operator's DLT platform (or MSG91's DLT-assist flow) AFTER they approve the exact content in this file. No tool, including me, can generate these — they come from a real regulatory approval step you have to complete.
next_steps: 1. Register as a Principal Entity (PE) on your telecom operator's DLT platform (Airtel IQ / Jio DLT / Vodafone Idea MyOperator) if not already done — or use MSG91's built-in DLT registration assistance.
2. Submit the exact 'content' string below (do not alter punctuation or spacing) for template approval, with 'AviQR' as the brand name.

3. Confirm the variable placeholder syntax directly in MSG91's template form before submitting — I found MSG91's own documentation inconsistent between {#var#} and ##var##, and could not resolve which applies to DLT submission vs. their Flow API call. Use whatever their form's own inline example shows.
4. Once approved, you'll receive a numeric DLT Template ID; fill that plus your registered Sender ID into MSG91's dashboard manually.
5. Update this file's dlt_template_id/sender_id fields for your own records once you have them.

templates.content: Your AviQR verification code is {#var#}. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share this code.
templates.variable_note: Confirm exact placeholder syntax ({#var#} vs ##var##) against MSG91's own form before DLT submission — see _readme.next_steps item 3.
templates.used_for: Login and registration OTP delivery — auth-service publishes an otp.requested event over RabbitMQ, notification-report-review-service consumes it and sends this SMS.
templates.sent_via_note: Currently implemented against Twilio's API directly (TwilioSmsService.java), not MSG91. Switching the OTP send path to MSG91 requires a separate code change beyond DLT template registration.

not_covered.crm_campaign_sms: shop-mall-service/CampaignService.java (birthday/anniversary wishes, segment broadcasts) sends free-form text each shop owner composes themselves — no fixed content, so it can't be pre-registered as one DLT template like OTP can. Needs a separate decision: restrict owners to pre-approved template variants, or use MSG91's dynamic-template DLT category.
